% Explicit ticks on a log axis, fixed-point log labels, embedded TikZ at bare and axis cs coordinates.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{loglogaxis}[xmin=1, xmax=1000, ymin=0.01, ymax=100, xtick={1,5,50,500}, log ticks with fixed point]
  \addplot coordinates {(1,0.02) (20,1) (1000,50)};
  \draw[red] (10,0.1) -- (100,10);
  \node[draw] at (axis cs:300,0.05) {A};
\end{loglogaxis}
\end{tikzpicture}
